turns.assessment: There is no corroborating optical or service symptom at t≈600 s. All receiver quality metrics on trx.och43.z, the far-end interface, channel monitors, and amplifiers also show no change; documented optical faults would normally alter power, OSNR, BER, DGD, polarization, or multiple channels. A frozen/stale telemetry value is the most plausible interpretation, but telemetry failure is not a documented fault mode in the case, so no repairable listed cause can be identified confidently.

proposals.rationale: A local card problem could affect monitoring, but the documented CARD_FAIL mode predicts a down unit, invalid/silent monitoring, and traffic loss—not merely an unchanged valid-looking rx_power reading.
This is the only listed receiver-local soft fault, but it should produce a receiver penalty such as BER or margin degradation; pre-FEC BER, OSNR, and all other receiver metrics were unchanged.

score.why: cause flagged as unconsidered and absent
